# Spectrum design tokens

- Source: [@adobe/spectrum-tokens](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@adobe/spectrum-tokens) 15.5.0 (`dist/json/variables.json`), from registry.npmjs.org.
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`). © Adobe.
- Use: converted at build time by `tools/spectrum_theme` into the app's theme table (the QML singleton `Spectrum`). Light and dark themes, desktop scale.

To update, replace `variables.json` with the file from a newer package version and record the version here and in `docs/implementation-notes.md`.
